text_en: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Thecua: which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Ozias king of Juda , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joas king of Israel two years before the earthquake.
text_la: Verba Amos, qui fuit in pastoribus de Thecue, quæ vidit super Israël in diebus Oziæ, regis Juda, et in diebus Jeroboam, filii Joas, regis Israël, ante duos annos terræmotus.
text_pt: As palavras de Amós, que estava entre os pastores de Tecoa, as quais viu a respeito de Israel, nos dias de Uzias, rei de Judá, e nos dias de Jeroboão, filho de Joás, rei de Israel, dois anos antes do terremoto.
text_el: λόγοι Αμως οἳ ἐγένοντο ἐν νακκαριμ ἐκ Θεκουε οὓς εἶδεν ὑπὲρ Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ἡμέραις Οζιου βασιλέως Ιουδα καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις Ιεροβοαμ τοῦ Ιωας βασιλέως Ισραηλ πρὸ δύο ἐτῶν τοῦ σεισμοῦ

text_en: And he said: The Lord will roar from Sion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem : and the beautiful places of the shepherds have mourned, and the top of Carmel is withered.
text_la: Et dixit : Dominus de Sion rugiet, et de Jerusalem dabit vocem suam; et luxerunt speciosa pastorum, et exsiccatus est vertex Carmeli.
text_pt: Ele disse: O Senhor bramará de Sião, e de Jerusalém fará ouvir a sua voz; os prados dos pastores prantearão, e secar-se-á o cume do Carmelo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ἐκ Σιων ἐφθέγξατο καὶ ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ ἔδωκεν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπένθησαν αἱ νομαὶ τῶν ποιμένων καὶ ἐξηράνθη ἡ κορυφὴ τοῦ Καρμήλου

text_en: Thus says the Lord : For three crimes of Damascus , and for four I will not convert it: because they have thrashed Galaad with iron wains.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Super tribus sceleribus Damasci, et super quatuor non convertam eum, eo quod trituraverint in plaustris ferreis Galaad.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressões de Damasco, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque trilharam a Gileade com trilhos de ferro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ἐπὶ ταῖς τρισὶν ἀσεβείαις Δαμασκοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς τέσσαρσιν οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι αὐτόν ἀνθ' ὧν ἔπριζον πρίοσιν σιδηροῖς τὰς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσας τῶν ἐν Γαλααδ

text_en: And I will send a fire into the house of Azael, and it shall devour the houses of Benadad.
text_la: Et mittam ignem in domum Azaël, et devorabit domos Benadad.
text_pt: Por isso porei fogo à casa de Hazael, e ele consumirá os palácios de Ben-Hadade.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ πῦρ εἰς τὸν οἶκον Αζαηλ καὶ καταφάγεται θεμέλια υἱοῦ Αδερ

text_en: And I will break the bar of Damascus : and I will cut off the inhabitants from the plain of the idol , and him that holds the sceptre from the house of pleasure: and the people of Syria shall be carried away to Cyrene , says the Lord .
text_la: Et conteram vectem Damasci : et disperdam habitatorem de campo idoli, et tenentem sceptrum de domo voluptatis : et transferetur populus Syriæ Cyrenen, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E quebrarei o ferrolho de Damasco, e exterminarei o morador do vale de Áven, e ao que tem o cetro de Bete-Éden; e o povo da Síria será levado em cativeiro a Quir, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ συντρίψω μοχλοὺς Δαμασκοῦ καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω κατοικοῦντας ἐκ πεδίου Ων καὶ κατακόψω φυλὴν ἐξ ἀνδρῶν Χαρραν καὶ αἰχμαλωτευθήσεται λαὸς Συρίας ἐπίκλητος λέγει κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord : For three crimes of Gaza , and for four I will not convert it: because they have carried away a perfect captivity to shut them up in Edom .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Super tribus sceleribus Gazæ, et super quatuor non convertam eum, eo quod transtulerint captivitatem perfectam, ut concluderent eam in Idumæa.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressões de Gaza, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque levaram em cativeiro todos os cativos para os entregarem a Edom.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ ταῖς τρισὶν ἀσεβείαις Γάζης καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς τέσσαρσιν οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι αὐτούς ἕνεκεν τοῦ αἰχμαλωτεῦσαι αὐτοὺς αἰχμαλωσίαν τοῦ Σαλωμων τοῦ συγκλεῖσαι εἰς τὴν Ιδουμαίαν

text_en: And I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza , and it shall devour the houses thereof.
text_la: Et mittam ignem in murum Gazæ, et devorabit ædes ejus.
text_pt: Por isso porei fogo ao muro de Gaza, e ele consumirá os seus palácios.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ πῦρ ἐπὶ τὰ τείχη Γάζης καὶ καταφάγεται θεμέλια αὐτῆς

text_en: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Azotus , and him that holds the sceptre from Ascalon : and I will turn my hand against Accaron , and the rest of the Philistines shall perish, says the Lord God .
text_la: Et disperdam habitatorem de Azoto, et tenentem sceptrum de Ascalone : et convertam manum meam super Accaron, et peribunt reliqui Philisthinorum, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E exterminarei o morador de Asdode, e o que tem o cetro de Ascalom, e tornarei a minha mão contra Ecrom; e o restante dos filisteus perecerá, diz o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω κατοικοῦντας ἐξ Ἀζώτου καὶ ἐξαρθήσεται φυλὴ ἐξ Ἀσκαλῶνος καὶ ἐπάξω τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ Ακκαρων καὶ ἀπολοῦνται οἱ κατάλοιποι τῶν ἀλλοφύλων λέγει κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord : For three crimes of Tyre , and for four I will not convert it: because they have shut up an entire captivity in Edom , and have not remembered the covenant of brethren.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Super tribus sceleribus Tyri, et super quatuor non convertam eum, eo quod concluserint captivitatem perfectam in Idumæa, et non sint recordati fœderis fratrum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressões de Tiro, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque entregaram todos os cativos a Edom, e não se lembraram da aliança dos irmãos.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ ταῖς τρισὶν ἀσεβείαις Τύρου καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς τέσσαρσιν οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι αὐτήν ἀνθ' ὧν συνέκλεισαν αἰχμαλωσίαν τοῦ Σαλωμων εἰς τὴν Ιδουμαίαν καὶ οὐκ ἐμνήσθησαν διαθήκης ἀδελφῶν

text_en: And I will send a fire upon the wall of Tyre , and it shall devour the houses thereof.
text_la: Et mittam ignem in murum Tyri, et devorabit ædes ejus.
text_pt: Por isso porei fogo ao muro de Tiro, e ele consumirá os seus palácios.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ πῦρ ἐπὶ τὰ τείχη Τύρου καὶ καταφάγεται θεμέλια αὐτῆς

text_en: Thus says the Lord : For three crimes of Edom , and for four I will not convert him: because he has pursued his brother with the sword, and has cast off all pity, and has carried on his fury , and has kept his wrath to the end.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Super tribus sceleribus Edom, et super quatuor non convertam eum, eo quod persecutus sit in gladio fratrem suum, et violaverit misericordiam ejus, et tenuerit ultra furorem suum, et indignationem suam servaverit usque in finem.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressões de Edom, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque perseguiu a seu irmão à espada, e aniquilou as suas misericórdias; e a sua ira despedaçou eternamente, e conservou a sua indignação para sempre.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ ταῖς τρισὶν ἀσεβείαις τῆς Ιδουμαίας καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς τέσσαρσιν οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι αὐτούς ἕνεκα τοῦ διῶξαι αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλυμήνατο μήτραν ἐπὶ γῆς καὶ ἥρπασεν εἰς μαρτύριον φρίκην αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ὅρμημα αὐτοῦ ἐφύλαξεν εἰς νεῖκος

text_en: I will send a fire into Theman: and it shall devour the houses of Bosra.
text_la: Mittam ignem in Theman, et devorabit ædes Bosræ.
text_pt: Por isso porei fogo a Temã, e ele consumirá os palácios de Bozra.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ πῦρ εἰς Θαιμαν καὶ καταφάγεται θεμέλια τειχέων αὐτῆς

text_en: Thus says the Lord : For three crimes of the children of Ammon , and for four I will not convert him: because he has ripped up the women with child of Galaad to enlarge his border.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Super tribus sceleribus filiorum Ammon, et super quatuor non convertam eum, eo quod dissecuerit prægnantes Galaad ad dilatandum terminum suum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressões dos filhos de Amom, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque fenderam o ventre às grávidas de Gileade, para dilatarem os seus termos.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ ταῖς τρισὶν ἀσεβείαις υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς τέσσαρσιν οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι αὐτόν ἀνθ' ὧν ἀνέσχιζον τὰς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσας τῶν Γαλααδιτῶν ὅπως ἐμπλατύνωσιν τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν

text_en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabba: and it shall devour the houses thereof with shouting in the day of battle, and with a whirlwind in the day of trouble.
text_la: Et succendam ignem in muro Rabba, et devorabit ædes ejus in ululatu in die belli, et in turbine in die commotionis.
text_pt: Por isso porei fogo ao muro de Rabá, e ele consumirá os seus palácios, com alarido no dia da batalha, com tempestade no dia da tormenta.
text_el: καὶ ἀνάψω πῦρ ἐπὶ τὰ τείχη Ραββα καὶ καταφάγεται θεμέλια αὐτῆς μετὰ κραυγῆς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πολέμου καὶ σεισθήσεται ἐν ἡμέρᾳ συντελείας αὐτῆς

text_en: And Melchom shall go into captivity, both he, and his princes together, says the Lord .
text_la: Et ibit Melchom in captivitatem, ipse et principes ejus simul, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E o seu rei irá para o cativeiro, ele e os seus príncipes juntamente, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ πορεύσονται οἱ βασιλεῖς αὐτῆς ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό λέγει κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord : For three crimes of Moab , and for four I will not convert him: because he has burnt the bones of the king of Edom even to ashes.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Super tribus sceleribus Moab, et super quatuor non convertam eum, eo quod incenderit ossa regis Idumææ usque ad cinerem.
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Moabe, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque queimou os ossos do rei de Edom, até os tornar a cal.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ ταῖς τρισὶν ἀσεβείαις Μωαβ καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς τέσσαρσιν οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι αὐτόν ἀνθ' ὧν κατέκαυσαν τὰ ὀστᾶ βασιλέως τῆς Ιδουμαίας εἰς κονίαν

text_en: And I will send a fire into Moab , and it shall devour the houses of Carioth: and Moab shall die with a noise, with the sound of the trumpet:
text_la: Et mittam ignem in Moab, et devorabit ædes Carioth : et morietur in sonitu Moab, in clangore tubæ.
text_pt: Por isso porei fogo a Moabe, e consumirá os palácios de Queriote; e Moabe morrerá com grande estrondo, com alarido, com som de trombeta.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ πῦρ ἐπὶ Μωαβ καὶ καταφάγεται θεμέλια τῶν πόλεων αὐτῆς καὶ ἀποθανεῖται ἐν ἀδυναμίᾳ Μωαβ μετὰ κραυγῆς καὶ μετὰ φωνῆς σάλπιγγος

text_en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all his princes with him, says the Lord .
text_la: Et disperdam judicem de medio ejus, et omnes principes ejus interficiam cum eo, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E exterminarei o juiz do meio dele, e a todos os seus príncipes com ele matarei, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω κριτὴν ἐξ αὐτῆς καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἄρχοντας αὐτῆς ἀποκτενῶ μετ' αὐτοῦ λέγει κύριος

text_en: Thus says the Lord : For three crimes of Juda , and for four I will not convert him: because he has cast away the law of the Lord , and has not kept his commandments : for their idols have caused them to err , after which their fathers have walked.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Super tribus sceleribus Juda, et super quatuor non convertam eum, eo quod abjecerit legem Domini et mandata ejus non custodierit : deceperant enim eos idola sua, post quæ abierant patres eorum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressões de Judá, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque rejeitaram a lei do Senhor, e não guardaram os seus estatutos, antes se deixaram enganar por suas próprias mentiras, após as quais andaram seus pais.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ ταῖς τρισὶν ἀσεβείαις υἱῶν Ιουδα καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς τέσσαρσιν οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι αὐτόν ἕνεκα τοῦ ἀπώσασθαι αὐτοὺς τὸν νόμον κυρίου καὶ τὰ προστάγματα αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο καὶ ἐπλάνησεν αὐτοὺς τὰ μάταια αὐτῶν ἃ ἐποίησαν οἷς ἐξηκολούθησαν οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν

text_en: And I will send a fire into Juda , and it shall devour the houses of Jerusalem .
text_la: Et mittam ignem in Juda, et devorabit ædes Jerusalem.
text_pt: Por isso porei fogo a Judá, e ele consumirá os palácios de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ πῦρ ἐπὶ Ιουδαν καὶ καταφάγεται θεμέλια Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Thus says the Lord : For three crimes of Israel , and for four I will not convert him: because he has sold the just man for silver, and the poor man for a pair of shoes.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Super tribus sceleribus Israël, et super quatuor non convertam eum, pro eo quod vendiderit pro argento justum, et pauperem pro calceamentis.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressões de Israel, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque vendem o justo por dinheiro, e o necessitado por um par de sapatos,
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ ταῖς τρισὶν ἀσεβείαις Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς τέσσαρσιν οὐκ ἀποστραφήσομαι αὐτόν ἀνθ' ὧν ἀπέδοντο ἀργυρίου δίκαιον καὶ πένητα ἕνεκεν ὑποδημάτων

text_en: They bruise the heads of the poor upon the dust of the earth, and turn aside the way of the humble : and the son and his father have gone to the same young woman , to profane my holy name .
text_la: Qui conterunt super pulverem terræ capita pauperum, et viam humilium declinant : et filius ac pater ejus ierunt ad puellam, ut violarent nomen sanctum meum.
text_pt: Suspirando pelo pó da terra, sobre a cabeça dos pobres, pervertem o caminho dos mansos; e um homem e seu pai entram à mesma moça, para profanarem o meu santo nome.
text_el: τὰ πατοῦντα ἐπὶ τὸν χοῦν τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκονδύλιζον εἰς κεφαλὰς πτωχῶν καὶ ὁδὸν ταπεινῶν ἐξέκλιναν καὶ υἱὸς καὶ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ εἰσεπορεύοντο πρὸς τὴν αὐτὴν παιδίσκην ὅπως βεβηλώσωσιν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτῶν

text_en: And they sat down upon garments laid to pledge by every altar : and drank the wine of the condemned in the house of their God .
text_la: Et super vestimentis pignoratis accubuerunt juxta omne altare, et vinum damnatorum bibebant in domo Dei sui.
text_pt: E se deitam junto a qualquer altar sobre roupas empenhadas, e na casa dos seus deuses bebem o vinho dos que tinham multado.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν δεσμεύοντες σχοινίοις παραπετάσματα ἐποίουν ἐχόμενα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ οἶνον ἐκ συκοφαντιῶν ἔπινον ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτῶν

text_en: Yet I cast out the Amorrhite before their face: whose height was like the height of cedars , and who was strong as an oak: and I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots beneath.
text_la: Ego autem exterminavi Amorrhæum a facie eorum, cujus altitudo, cedrorum altitudo ejus, et fortis ipse quasi quercus; et contrivi fructum ejus desuper, et radices ejus subter.
text_pt: Todavia eu destruí diante dele o amorreu, cuja altura era como a altura dos cedros, e que era forte como os carvalhos; mas destruí o seu fruto por cima, e as suas raízes por baixo.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐξῆρα τὸν Αμορραῖον ἐκ προσώπου αὐτῶν οὗ ἦν καθὼς ὕψος κέδρου τὸ ὕψος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰσχυρὸς ἦν ὡς δρῦς καὶ ἐξῆρα τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπάνωθεν καὶ τὰς ῥίζας αὐτοῦ ὑποκάτωθεν

text_en: It is I that brought you up out of the land of Egypt , and I led you forty years through the wilderness , that you might possess the land of the Amorrhite .
text_la: Ego sum qui ascendere vos feci de terra Ægypti, et duxi vos in deserto quadraginta annis, ut possideretis terram Amorrhæi.
text_pt: Também vos fiz subir da terra do Egito, e quarenta anos vos guiei no deserto, para que possuísseis a terra do amorreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἀνήγαγον ὑμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ περιήγαγον ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη τοῦ κατακληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν τῶν Αμορραίων

text_en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets , and of your young men for Nazarites . Is it not so, O you children of Israel , says the Lord ?
text_la: Et suscitavi de filiis vestris in prophetas, et de juvenibus vestris nazaræos. Numquid non ita est, filii Israël? dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E dentre vossos filhos suscitei profetas, e dentre os vossos jovens nazireus. Não é isto assim, filhos de Israel? diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν ὑμῶν εἰς προφήτας καὶ ἐκ τῶν νεανίσκων ὑμῶν εἰς ἁγιασμόν μὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ταῦτα υἱοὶ Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος

text_en: And you will present wine to the Nazarites : and command the prophets , saying: Prophesy not.
text_la: Et propinabitis nazaræis vinum, et prophetis mandabitis, dicentes : Ne prophetetis.
text_pt: Mas vós aos nazireus destes vinho a beber, e aos profetas ordenastes, dizendo: Não profetizareis.
text_el: καὶ ἐποτίζετε τοὺς ἡγιασμένους οἶνον καὶ τοῖς προφήταις ἐνετέλλεσθε λέγοντες οὐ μὴ προφητεύσητε

text_en: Behold, I will screak under you as a wain screaks that is laden with hay.
text_la: Ecce ego stridebo subter vos, sicut stridet plaustrum onustum fœno.
text_pt: Eis que eu vos apertarei no vosso lugar como se aperta um carro cheio de feixes.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ κυλίω ὑποκάτω ὑμῶν ὃν τρόπον κυλίεται ἡ ἅμαξα ἡ γέμουσα καλάμης

text_en: And flight shall perish from the swift, and the valiant shall not possess his strength, neither shall the strong save his life .
text_la: Et peribit fuga a veloce, et fortis non obtinebit virtutem suam, et robustus non salvabit animam suam :
text_pt: Assim perecerá a fuga ao ágil; nem o forte corroborará a sua força, nem o poderoso livrará a sua vida.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολεῖται φυγὴ ἐκ δρομέως καὶ ὁ κραταιὸς οὐ μὴ κρατήσῃ τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ μαχητὴς οὐ μὴ σώσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he that holds the bow shall not stand, and the swift of foot shall not escape, neither shall the rider of the horse save his life .
text_la: et tenens arcum non stabit, et velox pedibus suis non salvabitur, et ascensor equi non salvabit animam suam :
text_pt: E não ficará em pé o que maneja o arco, nem o ligeiro de pés se livrará, nem tampouco se livrará o que vai montado a cavalo.
text_el: καὶ ὁ τοξότης οὐ μὴ ὑποστῇ καὶ ὁ ὀξὺς τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ διασωθῇ οὐδὲ ὁ ἱππεὺς οὐ μὴ σώσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the stout of heart among the valiant shall flee away naked in that day, says the Lord .
text_la: et robustus corde inter fortes nudus fugiet in illa die, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E o mais corajoso entre os fortes fugirá nu naquele dia, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εὑρήσει τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ἐν δυναστείαις ὁ γυμνὸς διώξεται ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγει κύριος

text_en: Hear the word that the Lord has spoken concerning you, O you children of Israel : concerning the whole family that I brought up out of the land of Egypt , saying:
text_la: Audite verbum quod locutus est Dominus super vos, filii Israël, super omnem cognationem quam eduxi de terra Ægypti, dicens :
text_pt: Ouvi esta palavra que o SENHOR fala contra vós, filhos de Israel, contra toda a família que fiz subir da terra do Egito, dizendo:
text_el: ἀκούσατε τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ὃν ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐφ' ὑμᾶς οἶκος Ισραηλ καὶ κατὰ πάσης φυλῆς ἧς ἀνήγαγον ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου λέγων

text_en: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore will I visit upon you all your iniquities .
text_la: Tantummodo vos cognovi ex omnibus cognationibus terræ; idcirco visitabo super vos omnes iniquitates vestras.
text_pt: De todas as famílias da terra só a vós vos tenho conhecido; portanto eu vos punirei por todas as vossas iniqüidades.
text_el: πλὴν ὑμᾶς ἔγνων ἐκ πασῶν φυλῶν τῆς γῆς διὰ τοῦτο ἐκδικήσω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας ὑμῶν

text_en: Shall two walk together except they be agreed?
text_la: Numquid ambulabunt duo pariter, nisi convenerit eis?
text_pt: Porventura andarão dois juntos, se não estiverem de acordo?
text_el: εἰ πορεύσονται δύο ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καθόλου ἐὰν μὴ γνωρίσωσιν ἑαυτούς

text_en: Will a lion roar in the forest, if he have no prey? Will the lion's whelp cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
text_la: numquid rugiet leo in saltu, nisi habuerit prædam? numquid dabit catulus leonis vocem de cubili suo, nisi aliquid apprehenderit?
text_pt: Rugirá o leão no bosque, sem que tenha presa? Levantará o leãozinho no seu covil a sua voz, se nada tiver apanhado?
text_el: εἰ ἐρεύξεται λέων ἐκ τοῦ δρυμοῦ αὐτοῦ θήραν οὐκ ἔχων εἰ δώσει σκύμνος φωνὴν αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς μάνδρας αὐτοῦ καθόλου ἐὰν μὴ ἁρπάσῃ τι

text_en: Will the bird fall into the snare upon the earth, if there be no fowler? Shall the snare be taken up from the earth, before it has taken somewhat?
text_la: numquid cadet avis in laqueum terræ absque aucupe? numquid auferetur laqueus de terra antequam quid ceperit?
text_pt: Cairá a ave no laço em terra, se não houver armadilha para ela? Levantar-se-á da terra o laço, sem que tenha apanhado alguma coisa?
text_el: εἰ πεσεῖται ὄρνεον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἄνευ ἰξευτοῦ εἰ σχασθήσεται παγὶς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἄνευ τοῦ συλλαβεῖν τι

text_en: Shall the trumpet sound in a city, and the people not be afraid? Shall there be evil in a city, which the Lord has not done?
text_la: si clanget tuba in civitate, et populus non expavescet? si erit malum in civitate, quod Dominus non fecerit?
text_pt: Tocar-se-á a trombeta na cidade, e o povo não estremecerá? Sucederá algum mal na cidade, sem que o Senhor o tenha feito?
text_el: εἰ φωνήσει σάλπιγξ ἐν πόλει καὶ λαὸς οὐ πτοηθήσεται εἰ ἔσται κακία ἐν πόλει ἣν κύριος οὐκ ἐποίησεν

text_en: For the Lord God does nothing without revealing his secret to his servants the prophets .
text_la: Quia non facit Dominus Deus verbum, nisi revelaverit secretum suum ad servos suos prophetas.
text_pt: Certamente o Senhor DEUS não fará coisa alguma, sem ter revelado o seu segredo aos seus servos, os profetas.
text_el: διότι οὐ μὴ ποιήσῃ κύριος ὁ θεὸς πρᾶγμα ἐὰν μὴ ἀποκαλύψῃ παιδείαν αὐτοῦ πρὸς τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ τοὺς προφήτας

text_en: The lion shall roar, who will not fear ? The Lord God has spoken, who shall not prophesy ?
text_la: Leo rugiet, quis non timebit? Dominus Deus locutus est, quis non prophetabit?
text_pt: Rugiu o leão, quem não temerá? Falou o Senhor DEUS, quem não profetizará?
text_el: λέων ἐρεύξεται καὶ τίς οὐ φοβηθήσεται κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐλάλησεν καὶ τίς οὐ προφητεύσει

text_en: Publish it in the houses of Azotus , and in the houses of the land of Egypt , and say: Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria , and behold the many follies in the midst thereof, and them that suffer oppression in the inner rooms thereof.
text_la: Auditum facite in ædibus Azoti, et in ædibus terræ Ægypti, et dicite : Congregamini super montes Samariæ, et videte insanias multas in medio ejus, et calumniam patientes in penetralibus ejus.
text_pt: Fazei ouvir isso nos palácios de Asdode, e nos palácios da terra do Egito, e dizei: Ajuntai-vos sobre os montes de Samaria, e vede que grandes alvoroços há no meio dela, e como são oprimidos dentro dela.
text_el: ἀπαγγείλατε χώραις ἐν Ἀσσυρίοις καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς χώρας τῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ εἴπατε συνάχθητε ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος Σαμαρείας καὶ ἴδετε θαυμαστὰ πολλὰ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν καταδυναστείαν τὴν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And they have not known to do the right thing, says the Lord , storing up iniquity , and robberies in their houses.
text_la: Et nescierunt facere rectum, dicit Dominus, thesaurizantes iniquitatem et rapinas in ædibus suis.
text_pt: Porque não sabem fazer o que é reto, diz o Senhor, aqueles que entesouram nos seus palácios a violência e a destruição.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔγνω ἃ ἔσται ἐναντίον αὐτῆς λέγει κύριος οἱ θησαυρίζοντες ἀδικίαν καὶ ταλαιπωρίαν ἐν ταῖς χώραις αὐτῶν

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : The land shall be in tribulation, and shall be compassed about: and your strength shall be taken away from you, and your houses shall be spoiled.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Tribulabitur et circuietur terra : et detrahetur ex te fortitudo tua, et diripientur ædes tuæ.
text_pt: Portanto, o Senhor DEUS diz assim: O inimigo virá, e cercará a terra, derrubará a tua fortaleza, e os teus palácios serão saqueados.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός Τύρος κυκλόθεν ἡ γῆ σου ἐρημωθήσεται καὶ κατάξει ἐκ σοῦ ἰσχύν σου καὶ διαρπαγήσονται αἱ χῶραί σου

text_en: Thus says the Lord : As if a shepherd should get out of the lion's mouth two legs, or the tip of the ear: so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria , in a place of a bed, and in the couch of Damascus .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Quomodo si eruat pastor de ore leonis duo crura, aut extremum auriculæ, sic eruentur filii Israël, qui habitant in Samaria in plaga lectuli, et in Damasci grabato.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Como o pastor livra da boca do leão as duas pernas, ou um pedaço da orelha, assim serão livrados os filhos de Israel que habitam em Samaria, no canto da cama, e no damasco do leito.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ὃν τρόπον ὅταν ἐκσπάσῃ ὁ ποιμὴν ἐκ στόματος τοῦ λέοντος δύο σκέλη ἢ λοβὸν ὠτίου οὕτως ἐκσπασθήσονται οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ κατέναντι φυλῆς καὶ ἐν Δαμασκῷ ἱερεῖς

text_en: Hear, and testify in the house of Jacob , says the Lord the God of hosts :
text_la: Audite, et contestamini in domo Jacob, dicit Dominus Deus exercituum;
text_pt: Ouvi, e protestai contra a casa de Jacó, diz o Senhor DEUS, o Deus dos Exércitos;
text_el: ἀκούσατε καὶ ἐπιμαρτύρασθε τῷ οἴκῳ Ιακωβ λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ

text_en: That in the day when I shall begin to visit the transgressions of Israel , I will visit upon him, and upon the altars of Bethel : and the horns of the altars shall be cut off, and shall fall to the ground.
text_la: quia in die cum visitare cœpero prævaricationes Israël, super eum visitabo, et super altaria Bethel; et amputabuntur cornua altaris, et cadent in terram.
text_pt: Pois no dia em que eu punir as transgressões de Israel, também castigarei os altares de Betel; e as pontas do altar serão cortadas, e cairão por terra.
text_el: διότι ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὅταν ἐκδικῶ ἀσεβείας τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπὶ τὰ θυσιαστήρια Βαιθηλ καὶ κατασκαφήσεται τὰ κέρατα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ πεσοῦνται ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And I will strike the winter house with the summer house: and the houses of ivory shall perish, and many houses shall be destroyed, says the Lord .
text_la: Et percutiam domum hiemalem cum domo æstiva, et peribunt domus eburneæ, et dissipabuntur ædes multæ, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E ferirei a casa de inverno juntamente com a casa de verão; e as casas de marfim perecerão, e as grandes casas terão fim, diz o Senhor.
text_el: συγχεῶ καὶ πατάξω τὸν οἶκον τὸν περίπτερον ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τὸν θερινόν καὶ ἀπολοῦνται οἶκοι ἐλεφάντινοι καὶ προστεθήσονται οἶκοι ἕτεροι πολλοί λέγει κύριος

text_en: Hear this word, you fat kine that are in the mountains of Samaria : you that oppress the needy , and crush the poor : that say to your masters: Bring, and we will drink.
text_la: Audite verbum hoc, vaccæ pingues, quæ estis in monte Samariæ, quæ calumniam facitis egenis et confringitis pauperes; quæ dicitis dominis vestris : Afferte, et bibemus.
text_pt: Ouvi esta palavra vós, vacas de Basã, que estais no monte de Samaria, que oprimis aos pobres, que esmagais os necessitados, que dizeis a vossos senhores: Dai cá, e bebamos.
text_el: ἀκούσατε τὸν λόγον τοῦτον δαμάλεις τῆς Βασανίτιδος αἱ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῆς Σαμαρείας αἱ καταδυναστεύουσαι πτωχοὺς καὶ καταπατοῦσαι πένητας αἱ λέγουσαι τοῖς κυρίοις αὐτῶν ἐπίδοτε ἡμῖν ὅπως πίωμεν

text_en: The Lord God has sworn by his holiness , that lo, the days shall come upon you, when they shall lift you up on pikes, and what shall remain of you in boiling pots.
text_la: Juravit Dominus Deus in sancto suo, quia ecce dies venient super vos, et levabunt vos in contis, et reliquias vestras in ollis ferventibus.
text_pt: Jurou o Senhor DEUS, pela sua santidade, que dias estão para vir sobre vós, em que vos levarão com ganchos e a vossos descendentes com anzóis de pesca.
text_el: ὀμνύει κύριος κατὰ τῶν ἁγίων αὐτοῦ διότι ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καὶ λήμψονται ὑμᾶς ἐν ὅπλοις καὶ τοὺς μεθ' ὑμῶν εἰς λέβητας ὑποκαιομένους ἐμβαλοῦσιν ἔμπυροι λοιμοί

text_en: And you shall go out at the breaches one over against the other, and you shall be cast forth into Armon, says the Lord .
text_la: Et per aperturas exibitis altera contra alteram, et projiciemini in Armon, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E saireis pelas brechas, uma após outra, e sereis lançadas para Harmom, disse o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐξενεχθήσεσθε γυμναὶ κατέναντι ἀλλήλων καὶ ἀπορριφήσεσθε εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Ρεμμαν λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός

text_en: Come to Bethel , and do wickedly : to Galgal, and multiply transgressions : and bring in the morning your victims, your tithes in three days.
text_la: Venite ad Bethel, et impie agite; ad Galgalam, et multiplicate prævaricationem : et afferte mane victimas vestras, tribus diebus decimas vestras.
text_pt: Vinde a Betel, e transgredi; a Gilgal, e multiplicai as transgressões; e cada manhã trazei os vossos sacrifícios, e os vossos dízimos de três em três dias.
text_el: εἰσήλθατε εἰς Βαιθηλ καὶ ἠνομήσατε καὶ εἰς Γαλγαλα ἐπληθύνατε τοῦ ἀσεβῆσαι καὶ ἠνέγκατε εἰς τὸ πρωὶ θυσίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν τριημερίαν τὰ ἐπιδέκατα ὑμῶν

text_en: And offer a sacrifice of praise with leaven: and call free offerings , and proclaim it: for so you would do, O children of Israel , says the Lord God .
text_la: Et sacrificate de fermentato laudem, et vocate voluntarias oblationes, et annuntiate; sic enim voluistis, filii Israël, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E oferecei o sacrifício de louvores do que é levedado, e apregoai as ofertas voluntárias, publicai-as; porque disso gostais, ó filhos de Israel, disse o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέγνωσαν ἔξω νόμον καὶ ἐπεκαλέσαντο ὁμολογίας ἀπαγγείλατε ὅτι ταῦτα ἠγάπησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός

text_en: Whereupon I also have given you dullness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet you have not returned to me, says the Lord .
text_la: Unde et ego dedi vobis stuporem dentium in cunctis urbibus vestris, et indigentiam panum in omnibus locis vestris; et non estis reversi ad me, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Por isso também vos dei limpeza de dentes em todas as vossas cidades, e falta de pão em todos os vossos lugares; contudo não vos convertestes a mim, disse o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ δώσω ὑμῖν γομφιασμὸν ὀδόντων ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν ὑμῶν καὶ ἔνδειαν ἄρτων ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς τόποις ὑμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἐπεστρέψατε πρός με λέγει κύριος

text_en: I also have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon: and the piece whereupon I rained not, withered.
text_la: Ego quoque prohibui a vobis imbrem, cum adhuc tres menses superessent usque ad messem : et plui super unam civitatem, et super alteram civitatem non plui; pars una compluta est, et pars super quam non plui, aruit.
text_pt: Além disso, retive de vós a chuva quando ainda faltavam três meses para a ceifa; e fiz que chovesse sobre uma cidade, e não chovesse sobre a outra cidade; sobre um campo choveu, mas o outro, sobre o qual não choveu, secou-se.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἀνέσχον ἐξ ὑμῶν τὸν ὑετὸν πρὸ τριῶν μηνῶν τοῦ τρυγήτου καὶ βρέξω ἐπὶ πόλιν μίαν ἐπὶ δὲ πόλιν μίαν οὐ βρέξω μερὶς μία βραχήσεται καὶ μερίς ἐφ' ἣν οὐ βρέξω ἐπ' αὐτήν ξηρανθήσεται

text_en: And two and three cities went to one city to drink water, and were not filled: yet you returned not to me, says the Lord .
text_la: Et venerunt duæ et tres civitates ad unam civitatem ut biberent aquam, et non sunt satiatæ; et non redistis ad me, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E andaram errantes duas ou três cidades, indo a outra cidade para beberem água, mas não se saciaram; contudo não vos convertestes a mim, disse o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ συναθροισθήσονται δύο καὶ τρεῖς πόλεις εἰς πόλιν μίαν τοῦ πιεῖν ὕδωρ καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐμπλησθῶσιν καὶ οὐκ ἐπεστρέψατε πρός με λέγει κύριος

text_en: I struck you with a burning wind, and with mildew, the palmerworm has eaten up your many gardens, and your vineyards: your olive groves, and fig groves: yet you returned not to me, says the Lord .
text_la: Percussi vos in vento urente, et in aurugine : multitudinem hortorum vestrorum et vinearum vestrarum, oliveta vestra et ficeta vestra comedit eruca : et non redistis ad me, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Feri-vos com queimadura, e com ferrugem; a multidão das vossas hortas, e das vossas vinhas, e das vossas figueiras, e das vossas oliveiras, comeu a locusta; contudo não vos convertestes a mim, disse o Senhor.
text_el: ἐπάταξα ὑμᾶς ἐν πυρώσει καὶ ἐν ἰκτέρῳ ἐπληθύνατε κήπους ὑμῶν ἀμπελῶνας ὑμῶν καὶ συκῶνας ὑμῶν καὶ ἐλαιῶνας ὑμῶν κατέφαγεν ἡ κάμπη καὶ οὐδ' ὧς ἐπεστρέψατε πρός με λέγει κύριος

text_en: I sent death upon you in the way of Egypt , I slew your young men with the sword, even to the captivity of your horses: and I made the stench of your camp to come up into your nostrils: yet you returned not to me, says the Lord .
text_la: Misi in vos mortem in via Ægypti; percussi in gladio juvenes vestros, usque ad captivitatem equorum vestrorum, et ascendere feci putredinem castrorum vestrorum in nares vestras : et non redistis ad me, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Enviei a peste contra vós, à maneira do Egito; os vossos jovens matei à espada, e os vossos cavalos deixei levar presos, e o mau cheiro dos vossos arraiais fiz subir às vossas narinas; contudo não vos convertestes a mim, disse o Senhor.
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλα εἰς ὑμᾶς θάνατον ἐν ὁδῷ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἀπέκτεινα ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ τοὺς νεανίσκους ὑμῶν μετὰ αἰχμαλωσίας ἵππων σου καὶ ἀνήγαγον ἐν πυρὶ τὰς παρεμβολὰς ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου καὶ οὐδ' ὧς ἐπεστρέψατε πρός με λέγει κύριος

text_en: I destroyed some of you, as God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrha , and you were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet you returned not to me, says the Lord .
text_la: Subverti vos sicut subvertit Deus Sodomam et Gomorrham, et facti estis quasi torris raptus ab incendio : et non redistis ad me, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Subverti a alguns dentre vós, como Deus subverteu a Sodoma e Gomorra, e vós fostes como um tição arrebatado do incêndio; contudo não vos convertestes a mim, disse o Senhor.
text_el: κατέστρεψα ὑμᾶς καθὼς κατέστρεψεν ὁ θεὸς Σοδομα καὶ Γομορρα καὶ ἐγένεσθε ὡς δαλὸς ἐξεσπασμένος ἐκ πυρός καὶ οὐδ' ὧς ἐπεστρέψατε πρός με λέγει κύριος

text_en: Therefore I will do these things to you, O Israel : and after I shall have done these things to you, be prepared to meet your God , O Israel .
text_la: Quapropter hæc faciam tibi, Israël : postquam autem hæc fecero tibi, præparare in occursum Dei tui, Israël.
text_pt: Portanto, assim te farei, ó Israel! E porque isso te farei, prepara-te, ó Israel, para te encontrares com o teu Deus.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὕτως ποιήσω σοι Ισραηλ πλὴν ὅτι οὕτως ποιήσω σοι ἑτοιμάζου τοῦ ἐπικαλεῖσθαι τὸν θεόν σου Ισραηλ

text_en: For behold he that forms the mountains and creates the wind, and declares his word to man , he that makes the morning mist, and walks upon the high places of the earth: the Lord the God of hosts is his name .
text_la: Quia ecce formans montes, et creans ventum, et annuntians homini eloquium suum, faciens matutinam nebulam, et gradiens super excelsa terræ : Dominus Deus exercituum nomen ejus.
text_pt: Porque eis aqui o que forma os montes, e cria o vento, e declara ao homem qual seja o seu pensamento, o que faz da manhã trevas, e pisa os altos da terra; o Senhor, o Deus dos Exércitos, é o seu nome.
text_el: διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ στερεῶν βροντὴν καὶ κτίζων πνεῦμα καὶ ἀπαγγέλλων εἰς ἀνθρώπους τὸν χριστὸν αὐτοῦ ποιῶν ὄρθρον καὶ ὁμίχλην καὶ ἐπιβαίνων ἐπὶ τὰ ὕψη τῆς γῆς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ὄνομα αὐτῷ

text_en: Hear this word, which I take up concerning you for a lamentation. The house of Israel is fallen, and it shall rise no more.
text_la: Audite verbum istud, quod ego levo super vos planctum : domus Israël cecidit, et non adjiciet ut resurgat.
text_pt: Ouvi esta palavra, que levanto como uma lamentação sobre vós, ó casa de Israel.
text_el: ἀκούσατε τὸν λόγον κυρίου τοῦτον ὃν ἐγὼ λαμβάνω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς θρῆνον οἶκος Ισραηλ

text_en: The virgin of Israel is cast down upon her land, there is none to raise her up.
text_la: Virgo Israël projecta est in terram suam, non est qui suscitet eam.
text_pt: A virgem de Israel caiu, e não mais tornará a levantar-se; desamparada está na sua terra, não há quem a levante.
text_el: ἔπεσεν οὐκέτι μὴ προσθῇ τοῦ ἀναστῆναι παρθένος τοῦ Ισραηλ ἔσφαλεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς αὐτῆς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἀναστήσων αὐτήν

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : The city, out of which came forth a thousand, there shall be left in it a hundred: and out of which there came a hundred, there shall be left in it ten, in the house of Israel .
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Urbs de qua egrediebantur mille, relinquentur in ea centum; et de qua egrediebantur centum, relinquentur in ea decem in domo Israël.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: A cidade da qual saem mil conservará cem, e aquela da qual saem cem conservará dez, para a casa de Israel.
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος κύριος ἡ πόλις ἐξ ἧς ἐξεπορεύοντο χίλιοι ὑπολειφθήσονται ἑκατόν καὶ ἐξ ἧς ἐξεπορεύοντο ἑκατόν ὑπολειφθήσονται δέκα τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ

text_en: For thus says the Lord to the house of Israel : Seek me, and you shall live.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus domui Israël : Quærite me, et vivetis.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor à casa de Israel: Buscai-me, e vivei.
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει κύριος πρὸς τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ ἐκζητήσατέ με καὶ ζήσεσθε

text_en: But seek not Bethel , and go not into Galgal, neither shall you pass over to Bersabee : for Galgal shall go into captivity, and Bethel shall be unprofitable.
text_la: Et nolite quærere Bethel, et in Galgalam nolite intrare, et in Bersabee non transibitis, quia Galgala captiva ducetur, et Bethel erit inutilis.
text_pt: Mas não busqueis a Betel, nem venhais a Gilgal, nem passeis a Berseba, porque Gilgal certamente será levada ao cativeiro, e Betel será desfeita em nada.
text_el: καὶ μὴ ἐκζητεῖτε Βαιθηλ καὶ εἰς Γαλγαλα μὴ εἰσπορεύεσθε καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ ὅρκου μὴ διαβαίνετε ὅτι Γαλγαλα αἰχμαλωτευομένη αἰχμαλωτευθήσεται καὶ Βαιθηλ ἔσται ὡς οὐχ ὑπάρχουσα

text_en: Seek the Lord , and live: lest the house of Joseph be burnt with fire, and it shall devour, and there shall be none to quench Bethel .
text_la: Quærite Dominum, et vivite (ne forte comburatur ut ignis domus Joseph, et devorabit, et non erit qui extinguat Bethel :
text_pt: Buscai ao Senhor, e vivei, para que ele não irrompa na casa de José como um fogo, e a consuma, e não haja em Betel quem o apague.
text_el: ἐκζητήσατε τὸν κύριον καὶ ζήσατε ὅπως μὴ ἀναλάμψῃ ὡς πῦρ ὁ οἶκος Ιωσηφ καὶ καταφάγεται αὐτόν καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ σβέσων τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ

text_en: You that turn judgment into wormwood , and forsake justice in the land,
text_la: qui convertitis in absinthium judicium, et justitiam in terra relinquitis) :
text_pt: Vós que converteis o juízo em alosna, e deitais por terra a justiça,
text_el: κύριος ὁ ποιῶν εἰς ὕψος κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην εἰς γῆν ἔθηκεν

text_en: seek him that makes Arcturus, and Orion , and that turns darkness into morning, and that changes day into night: that calls the waters of the sea, and pours them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name .
text_la: facientem Arcturum et Orionem, et convertentem in mane tenebras, et diem in noctem mutantem; qui vocat aquas maris, et effundit eas super faciem terræ; Dominus nomen est ejus :
text_pt: Procurai o que faz o sete-estrêlo e o órion e torna a sombra da noite em manhã, e faz escurecer o dia como a noite, que chama as águas do mar, e as derrama sobre a terra; o Senhor é o seu nome.
text_el: ποιῶν πάντα καὶ μετασκευάζων καὶ ἐκτρέπων εἰς τὸ πρωὶ σκιὰν θανάτου καὶ ἡμέραν εἰς νύκτα συσκοτάζων ὁ προσκαλούμενος τὸ ὕδωρ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐκχέων αὐτὸ ἐπὶ προσώπου τῆς γῆς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ὄνομα αὐτῷ

text_en: He that with a smile brings destruction upon the strong, and waste upon the mighty.
text_la: qui subridet vastitatem super robustum, et depopulationem super potentem affert.
text_pt: O que promove súbita destruição contra o forte; de modo que venha a destruição contra a fortaleza.
text_el: ὁ διαιρῶν συντριμμὸν ἐπ' ἰσχὺν καὶ ταλαιπωρίαν ἐπὶ ὀχύρωμα ἐπάγων

text_en: They have hated him that rebukes in the gate: and have abhorred him that speaks perfectly.
text_la: Odio habuerunt corripientem in porta, et loquentem perfecte abominati sunt.
text_pt: Odeiam na porta ao que os repreende, e abominam ao que fala sinceramente.
text_el: ἐμίσησαν ἐν πύλαις ἐλέγχοντα καὶ λόγον ὅσιον ἐβδελύξαντο

text_en: Therefore because you robbed the poor , and took the choice prey from him: you shall build houses with square stone, and shall not dwell in them: you shall plant most delightful vineyards, and shall not drink the wine of them.
text_la: Idcirco, pro eo quod diripiebatis pauperem, et prædam electam tollebatis ab eo, domos quadro lapide ædificabitis, et non habitabitis in eis; vineas plantabis amantissimas, et non bibetis vinum earum.
text_pt: Portanto, visto que pisais o pobre e dele exigis um tributo de trigo, edificastes casas de pedras lavradas, mas nelas não habitareis; vinhas desejáveis plantastes, mas não bebereis do seu vinho.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀνθ' ὧν κατεκονδυλίζετε πτωχοὺς καὶ δῶρα ἐκλεκτὰ ἐδέξασθε παρ' αὐτῶν οἴκους ξυστοὺς ᾠκοδομήσατε καὶ οὐ μὴ κατοικήσητε ἐν αὐτοῖς ἀμπελῶνας ἐπιθυμητοὺς ἐφυτεύσατε καὶ οὐ μὴ πίητε τὸν οἶνον ἐξ αὐτῶν

text_en: Because I know your manifold crimes, and your grievous sins : enemies of the just , taking bribes , and oppressing the poor in the gate.
text_la: Quia cognovi multa scelera vestra, et fortia peccata vestra : hostes justi, accipientes munus, et pauperes deprimentes in porta.
text_pt: Porque sei que são muitas as vossas transgressões e graves os vossos pecados; afligis o justo, tomais resgate, e rejeitais os necessitados na porta.
text_el: ὅτι ἔγνων πολλὰς ἀσεβείας ὑμῶν καὶ ἰσχυραὶ αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ὑμῶν καταπατοῦντες δίκαιον λαμβάνοντες ἀλλάγματα καὶ πένητας ἐν πύλαις ἐκκλίνοντες

text_en: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence at that time, for it is an evil time.
text_la: Ideo prudens in tempore illo tacebit, quia tempus malum est.
text_pt: Portanto, o que for prudente guardará silêncio naquele tempo, porque o tempo será mau.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ὁ συνίων ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ σιωπήσεται ὅτι καιρὸς πονηρός ἐστιν

text_en: Seek good , and not evil , that you may live: and the Lord the God of hosts will be with you, as you have said.
text_la: Quærite bonum, et non malum, ut vivatis; et erit Dominus Deus exercituum vobiscum, sicut dixistis.
text_pt: Buscai o bem, e não o mal, para que vivais; e assim o Senhor, o Deus dos Exércitos, estará convosco, como dizeis.
text_el: ἐκζητήσατε τὸ καλὸν καὶ μὴ τὸ πονηρόν ὅπως ζήσητε καὶ ἔσται οὕτως μεθ' ὑμῶν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ὃν τρόπον εἴπατε

text_en: Hate evil , and love good , and establish judgment in the gate: it may be the Lord the God of hosts may have mercy on the remnant of Joseph .
text_la: Odite malum et diligite bonum, et constituite in porta judicium : si forte misereatur Dominus Deus exercituum reliquiis Joseph.
text_pt: Odiai o mal, e amai o bem, e estabelecei na porta o juízo. Talvez o Senhor Deus dos Exércitos tenha piedade do remanescente de José.
text_el: μεμισήκαμεν τὰ πονηρὰ καὶ ἠγαπήκαμεν τὰ καλά καὶ ἀποκαταστήσατε ἐν πύλαις κρίμα ὅπως ἐλεήσῃ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ τοὺς περιλοίπους τοῦ Ιωσηφ

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord the God of hosts the sovereign Lord : In every street there shall be wailing: and in all places that are without, they shall say: Alas, alas! And they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful in lamentation to lament.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus exercituum, dominator : In omnibus plateis planctus; et in cunctis quæ foris sunt, dicetur : Væ, væ! et vocabunt agricolam ad luctum, et ad planctum eos qui sciunt plangere.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor, o Deus dos Exércitos, o Senhor: Em todas as ruas haverá pranto, e em todas as estradas dirão: Ai! Ai! E ao lavrador chamarão para choro, e para pranto os que souberem prantear.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ἐν πάσαις πλατείαις κοπετός καὶ ἐν πάσαις ὁδοῖς ῥηθήσεται οὐαὶ οὐαί κληθήσεται γεωργὸς εἰς πένθος καὶ κοπετὸν καὶ εἰς εἰδότας θρῆνον

text_en: And in all vineyards there shall be wailing: because I will pass through in the midst of you, says the Lord .
text_la: Et in omnibus vineis erit planctus, quia pertransibo in medio tui, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E em todas as vinhas haverá pranto; porque passarei pelo meio de ti, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐν πάσαις ὁδοῖς κοπετός διότι διελεύσομαι διὰ μέσου σου εἶπεν κύριος

text_en: Woe to them that desire the day of the Lord : to what end is it for you? The day of the Lord is darkness, and not light.
text_la: Væ desiderantibus diem Domini! ad quid eam vobis? Dies Domini ista, tenebræ, et non lux.
text_pt: Ai daqueles que desejam o dia do Senhor! Para que quereis vós este dia do Senhor? Será de trevas e não de luz.
text_el: οὐαὶ οἱ ἐπιθυμοῦντες τὴν ἡμέραν κυρίου ἵνα τί αὕτη ὑμῖν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ κυρίου καὶ αὐτή ἐστιν σκότος καὶ οὐ φῶς

text_en: As if a man should flee from the face of a lion, and a bear should meet him: or enter into the house, and lean with his hand upon the wall, and a serpent should bite him.
text_la: Quomodo si fugiat vir a facie leonis, et occurrat ei ursus; et ingrediatur domum, et innitatur manu sua super parietem, et mordeat eum coluber.
text_pt: É como se um homem fugisse de diante do leão, e se encontrasse com ele o urso; ou como se entrando numa casa, a sua mão encostasse à parede, e fosse mordido por uma cobra.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον ὅταν φύγῃ ἄνθρωπος ἐκ προσώπου τοῦ λέοντος καὶ ἐμπέσῃ αὐτῷ ἡ ἄρκος καὶ εἰσπηδήσῃ εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπερείσηται τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν τοῖχον καὶ δάκῃ αὐτὸν ὁ ὄφις

text_en: Shall not the day of the Lord be darkness, and not light: and obscurity, and no brightness in it?
text_la: Numquid non tenebræ dies Domini, et non lux; et caligo, et non splendor in ea?
text_pt: Não será, pois, o dia do Senhor trevas e não luz, e escuridão, sem que haja resplendor?
text_el: οὐχὶ σκότος ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ κυρίου καὶ οὐ φῶς καὶ γνόφος οὐκ ἔχων φέγγος αὐτῇ

text_en: I hate , and have rejected your festivities: and I will not receive the odour of your assemblies.
text_la: Odi, et projeci festivitates vestras, et non capiam odorem cœtuum vestrorum.
text_pt: Odeio, desprezo as vossas festas, e as vossas assembléias solenes não me exalarão bom cheiro.
text_el: μεμίσηκα ἀπῶσμαι ἑορτὰς ὑμῶν καὶ οὐ μὴ ὀσφρανθῶ ἐν ταῖς πανηγύρεσιν ὑμῶν

text_en: And if you offer me holocausts , and your gifts , I will not receive them: neither will I regard the vows of your fat beasts.
text_la: Quod si obtuleritis mihi holocautomata, et munera vestra, non suscipiam; et vota pinguium vestrorum non respiciam.
text_pt: E ainda que me ofereçais holocaustos, ofertas de alimentos, não me agradarei delas; nem atentarei para as ofertas pacíficas de vossos animais gordos.
text_el: διότι καὶ ἐὰν ἐνέγκητέ μοι ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ θυσίας ὑμῶν οὐ προσδέξομαι αὐτά καὶ σωτηρίου ἐπιφανείας ὑμῶν οὐκ ἐπιβλέψομαι

text_en: Take away from me the tumult of your songs: and I will not hear the canticles of your harp.
text_la: Aufer a me tumultum carminum tuorum; et cantica lyræ tuæ non audiam.
text_pt: Afasta de mim o estrépito dos teus cânticos; porque não ouvirei as melodias das tuas violas.
text_el: μετάστησον ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἦχον ᾠδῶν σου καὶ ψαλμὸν ὀργάνων σου οὐκ ἀκούσομαι

text_en: But judgment shall be revealed as water, and justice as a mighty torrent.
text_la: Et revelabitur quasi aqua judicium, et justitia quasi torrens fortis.
text_pt: Corra, porém, o juízo como as águas, e a justiça como o ribeiro impetuoso.
text_el: καὶ κυλισθήσεται ὡς ὕδωρ κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνη ὡς χειμάρρους ἄβατος

text_en: Did you offer victims and sacrifices to me in the desert for forty years, O house of Israel ?
text_la: Numquid hostias et sacrificium obtulistis mihi in deserto quadraginta annis, domus Israël?
text_pt: Oferecestes-me vós sacrifícios e oblações no deserto por quarenta anos, ó casa de Israel?
text_el: μὴ σφάγια καὶ θυσίας προσηνέγκατέ μοι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη οἶκος Ισραηλ

text_en: But you carried a tabernacle for your Moloch , and the image of your idols , the star of your god, which you made to yourselves.
text_la: et portastis tabernaculum Moloch vestro, et imaginem idolorum vestrorum, sidus dei vestri, quæ fecistis vobis.
text_pt: Antes levastes a tenda de vosso Moloque, e a estátua das vossas imagens, a estrela do vosso deus, que fizestes para vós mesmos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνελάβετε τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ Μολοχ καὶ τὸ ἄστρον τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν Ραιφαν τοὺς τύπους αὐτῶν οὓς ἐποιήσατε ἑαυτοῖς

text_en: And I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus , says the Lord , the God of hosts is his name .
text_la: Et migrare vos faciam trans Damascum, dicit Dominus : Deus exercituum nomen ejus.
text_pt: Portanto vos levarei cativos, para além de Damasco, diz o Senhor, cujo nome é o Deus dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ μετοικιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐπέκεινα Δαμασκοῦ λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ὄνομα αὐτῷ

text_en: Woe to you that are wealthy in Sion , and to you that have confidence in the mountain of Samaria : you great men , heads of the people, that go in with state into the house of Israel .
text_la: Væ qui opulenti estis in Sion, et confiditis in monte Samariæ : optimates capita populorum, ingredientes pompatice domum Israël!
text_pt: Ai dos que vivem sossegados em Sião, e dos que estão confiados no monte de Samaria, que têm nome entre as primeiras das nações, e aos quais vem a casa de Israel!
text_el: οὐαὶ τοῖς ἐξουθενοῦσιν Σιων καὶ τοῖς πεποιθόσιν ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος Σαμαρείας ἀπετρύγησαν ἀρχὰς ἐθνῶν καὶ εἰσῆλθον αὐτοί οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Pass over to Chalane, and see, and go from thence into Emath the great: and go down into Geth of the Philistines , and to all the best kingdoms of these: if their border be larger than your border.
text_la: Transite in Chalane, et videte, et ite inde in Emath magnam, et descendite in Geth Palæstinorum, et ad optima quæque regna horum : si latior terminus eorum termino vestro est.
text_pt: Passai a Calne, e vede; e dali ide à grande Hamate; e depois descei a Gate dos filisteus; serão melhores que estes reinos? Ou maior o seu termo do que o vosso termo?
text_el: διάβητε πάντες καὶ ἴδετε καὶ διέλθατε ἐκεῖθεν εἰς Εμαθ Ραββα καὶ κατάβητε ἐκεῖθεν εἰς Γεθ ἀλλοφύλων τὰς κρατίστας ἐκ πασῶν τῶν βασιλειῶν τούτων εἰ πλέονα τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν ἐστιν τῶν ὑμετέρων ὁρίων

text_en: You that are separated unto the evil day: and that approach to the throne of iniquity ;
text_la: Qui separati estis in diem malum, et appropinquatis solio iniquitatis;
text_pt: Ó vós que afastais o dia mau, e fazeis chegar o assento da violência.
text_el: οἱ ἐρχόμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κακήν οἱ ἐγγίζοντες καὶ ἐφαπτόμενοι σαββάτων ψευδῶν

text_en: you that sleep upon beds of ivory , and are wanton on your couches: that eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the herd;
text_la: qui dormitis in lectis eburneis, et lascivitis in stratis vestris; qui comeditis agnum de grege, et vitulos de medio armenti;
text_pt: Ai dos que dormem em camas de marfim, e se estendem sobre os seus leitos, e comem os cordeiros do rebanho, e os bezerros do meio do curral;
text_el: οἱ καθεύδοντες ἐπὶ κλινῶν ἐλεφαντίνων καὶ κατασπαταλῶντες ἐπὶ ταῖς στρωμναῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσθοντες ἐρίφους ἐκ ποιμνίων καὶ μοσχάρια ἐκ μέσου βουκολίων γαλαθηνά

text_en: you that sing to the sound of the psaltery : they have thought themselves to have instruments of music like David ;
text_la: qui canitis ad vocem psalterii, sicut David putaverunt se habere vasa cantici,
text_pt: Que cantam ao som da viola, e inventam para si instrumentos musicais, assim como Davi;
text_el: οἱ ἐπικροτοῦντες πρὸς τὴν φωνὴν τῶν ὀργάνων ὡς ἑστῶτα ἐλογίσαντο καὶ οὐχ ὡς φεύγοντα

text_en: that drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best ointments : and they are not concerned for the affliction of Joseph .
text_la: bibentes vinum in phialis, et optimo unguento delibuti, et nihil patiebantur super contritione Joseph.
text_pt: Que bebem vinho em taças, e se ungem com o mais excelente óleo: mas não se afligem pela ruína de José;
text_el: οἱ πίνοντες τὸν διυλισμένον οἶνον καὶ τὰ πρῶτα μύρα χριόμενοι καὶ οὐκ ἔπασχον οὐδὲν ἐπὶ τῇ συντριβῇ Ιωσηφ

text_en: Wherefore now they shall go captive at the head of them that go into captivity : and the faction of the luxurious ones shall be taken away.
text_la: Quapropter nunc migrabunt in capite transmigrantium, et auferetur factio lascivientium.
text_pt: Portanto agora irão em cativeiro entre os primeiros dos que forem levados cativos, e cessarão os festins dos banqueteadores.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο νῦν αἰχμάλωτοι ἔσονται ἀπ' ἀρχῆς δυναστῶν καὶ ἐξαρθήσεται χρεμετισμὸς ἵππων ἐξ Εφραιμ

text_en: The Lord God has sworn by his own soul , says the Lord the God of hosts : I detest the pride of Jacob , and I hate his houses, and I will deliver up the city with the inhabitants thereof.
text_la: Juravit Dominus Deus in anima sua, dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : Detestor ego superbiam Jacob, et domos ejus odi, et tradam civitatem cum habitatoribus suis.
text_pt: Jurou o Senhor DEUS por si mesmo, diz o SENHOR, o Deus dos Exércitos: Abomino a soberba de Jacó, e odeio os seus palácios; por isso entregarei a cidade e tudo o que nela há.
text_el: ὅτι ὤμοσεν κύριος καθ' ἑαυτοῦ διότι βδελύσσομαι ἐγὼ πᾶσαν τὴν ὕβριν Ιακωβ καὶ τὰς χώρας αὐτοῦ μεμίσηκα καὶ ἐξαρῶ πόλιν σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν αὐτήν

text_en: And if there remain ten men in one house, they also shall die.
text_la: Quod si reliqui fuerint decem viri in domo una, et ipsi morientur.
text_pt: E acontecerá que, se numa casa ficarem dez homens, morrerão.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ὑπολειφθῶσιν δέκα ἄνδρες ἐν οἰκίᾳ μιᾷ καὶ ἀποθανοῦνται καὶ ὑπολειφθήσονται οἱ κατάλοιποι

text_en: And a man's kinsman shall take him up, and shall burn him, that he may carry the bones out of the house; and he shall say to him that is in the inner rooms of the house: Is there yet any with you?
text_la: Et tollet eum propinquus suus, et comburet eum, ut efferat ossa de domo; et dicet ei, qui in penetralibus domus est : Numquid adhuc est penes te?
text_pt: Quando o tio de alguém, aquele que o queima, o tomar para levar-lhe os ossos para fora da casa, e disser ao que estiver no mais interior da casa: Está ainda alguém contigo? E este responder: Ninguém; então lhe dirá ele: Cala-te, porque não devemos fazer menção do nome do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται οἱ οἰκεῖοι αὐτῶν καὶ παραβιῶνται τοῦ ἐξενέγκαι τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου καὶ ἐρεῖ τοῖς προεστηκόσι τῆς οἰκίας εἰ ἔτι ὑπάρχει παρὰ σοί

text_en: And he shall answer: There is an end. And he shall say to him: Hold your peace, and mention not the name of the Lord .
text_la: Et respondebit : Finis est. Et dicet ei : Tace, et non recorderis nominis Domini.
text_pt: Porque, eis que o Senhor ordena, e ferirá a casa grande de brechas, e a casa pequena de fendas.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖ οὐκέτι καὶ ἐρεῖ σίγα ἕνεκα τοῦ μὴ ὀνομάσαι τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου

text_en: For behold the Lord has commanded, and he will strike the greater house with breaches, and the lesser house with clefts.
text_la: Quia ecce Dominus mandabit, et percutiet domum majorem ruinis, et domum minorem scissionibus.
text_pt: Porventura correrão cavalos sobre rocha? Lavrar-se-á nela com bois? Mas vós haveis tornado o juízo em fel, e o fruto da justiça em alosna;
text_el: διότι ἰδοὺ κύριος ἐντέλλεται καὶ πατάξει τὸν οἶκον τὸν μέγαν θλάσμασιν καὶ τὸν οἶκον τὸν μικρὸν ῥάγμασιν

text_en: Can horses run upon the rocks, or can any one plough with buffles? For you have turned judgment into bitterness, and the fruit of justice into wormwood .
text_la: Numquid currere queunt in petris equi, aut arari potest in bubalis? quoniam convertistis in amaritudinem judicium, et fructum justitiæ in absinthium.
text_pt: Vós que vos alegrais do nada, vós que dizeis: Não é assim que por nossa própria força nos temos tornado poderosos?
text_el: εἰ διώξονται ἐν πέτραις ἵπποι εἰ παρασιωπήσονται ἐν θηλείαις ὅτι ὑμεῖς ἐξεστρέψατε εἰς θυμὸν κρίμα καὶ καρπὸν δικαιοσύνης εἰς πικρίαν

text_en: You that rejoice in a thing of nought: you that say: Have we not taken unto us horns by our own strength?
text_la: Qui lætamini in nihilo; qui dicitis : Numquid non in fortitudine nostra assumpsimus nobis cornua?
text_pt: Porque, eis que eu levantarei sobre vós, ó casa de Israel, uma nação, diz o Senhor, o Deus dos Exércitos, e oprimir-vos-á, desde a entrada de Hamate até ao ribeiro do deserto.
text_el: οἱ εὐφραινόμενοι ἐπ' οὐδενὶ λόγῳ οἱ λέγοντες οὐκ ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι ἡμῶν ἔσχομεν κέρατα

text_en: But behold, I will raise up a nation against you, O house of Israel , says the Lord the God of hosts ; and they shall destroy you from the entrance of Emath, even to the torrent of the desert .
text_la: Ecce enim suscitabo super vos, domus Israël, dicit Dominus Deus exercituum, gentem, et conteret vos ab introitu Emath usque ad torrentem deserti.
text_el: διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπεγείρω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ ἔθνος καὶ ἐκθλίψουσιν ὑμᾶς τοῦ μὴ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς Εμαθ καὶ ἕως τοῦ χειμάρρου τῶν δυσμῶν

text_en: These things the Lord God showed to me: and behold the locust was formed in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter rain, and lo, it was the latter rain after the king's mowing.
text_la: Hæc ostendit mihi Dominus Deus : et ecce fictor locustæ in principio germinantium serotini imbris, et ecce serotinus post tonsionem regis.
text_pt: O SENHOR DEUS assim me fez ver, e eis que ele formava gafanhotos no princípio do rebento da erva serôdia, e eis que era a erva serôdia depois de findas as ceifas do rei.
text_el: οὕτως ἔδειξέν μοι κύριος καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐπιγονὴ ἀκρίδων ἐρχομένη ἑωθινή καὶ ἰδοὺ βροῦχος εἷς Γωγ ὁ βασιλεύς

text_en: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, I said: O Lord God , be merciful, I beseech you: who shall raise up Jacob , for he is very little?
text_la: Et factum est, cum consummasset comedere herbam terræ, dixi : Domine Deus, propitius esto, obsecro; quis suscitabit Jacob, quia parvulus est?
text_pt: E aconteceu que, tendo eles comido completamente a erva da terra, eu disse: Senhor DEUS, perdoa, rogo-te; quem levantará a Jacó? pois ele é pequeno.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν συντελέσῃ τοῦ καταφαγεῖν τὸν χόρτον τῆς γῆς καὶ εἶπα κύριε κύριε ἵλεως γενοῦ τίς ἀναστήσει τὸν Ιακωβ ὅτι ὀλιγοστός ἐστιν

text_en: The Lord had pity upon this: It shall not be, said the Lord .
text_la: Misertus est Dominus super hoc : Non erit, dixit Dominus.
text_pt: Então o Senhor se arrependeu disso. Não acontecerá, disse o Senhor.
text_el: μετανόησον κύριε ἐπὶ τούτῳ καὶ τοῦτο οὐκ ἔσται λέγει κύριος

text_en: These things the Lord God showed to me: and behold the Lord called for judgment unto fire, and it devoured the great deep , and ate up a part at the same time.
text_la: Hæc ostendit mihi Dominus Deus : et ecce vocabat judicium ad ignem Dominus Deus; et devoravit abyssum multam, et comedit simul partem.
text_pt: Assim me mostrou o Senhor DEUS: Eis que o Senhor DEUS clamava, para contender com fogo; este consumiu o grande abismo, e também uma parte da terra.
text_el: οὕτως ἔδειξέν μοι κύριος καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐκάλεσεν τὴν δίκην ἐν πυρὶ κύριος καὶ κατέφαγε τὴν ἄβυσσον τὴν πολλὴν καὶ κατέφαγεν τὴν μερίδα

text_en: And I said: O Lord God , cease, I beseech you, who shall raise up Jacob , for he is a little one?
text_la: Et dixi : Domine Deus, quiesce, obsecro; quis suscitabit Jacob, quia parvulus est?
text_pt: Então eu disse: Senhor Deus, cessa, eu te peço; quem levantará a Jacó? pois é pequeno.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα κύριε κύριε κόπασον δή τίς ἀναστήσει τὸν Ιακωβ ὅτι ὀλιγοστός ἐστιν

text_en: The Lord had pity upon this. Yea this also shall not be, said the Lord God .
text_la: Misertus est Dominus super hoc : Sed et istud non erit, dixit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: E o SENHOR se arrependeu disso. Nem isso acontecerá, disse o Senhor DEUS.
text_el: μετανόησον κύριε ἐπὶ τούτῳ καὶ τοῦτο οὐ μὴ γένηται λέγει κύριος

text_en: These things the Lord showed to me: and behold the Lord was standing upon a plastered wall, and in his hand a mason's trowel.
text_la: Hæc ostendit mihi Dominus : et ecce Dominus stans super murum litum, et in manu ejus trulla cæmentarii.
text_pt: Mostrou-me também assim: e eis que o Senhor estava sobre um muro, levantado a prumo; e tinha um prumo na sua mão.
text_el: οὕτως ἔδειξέν μοι κύριος καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἑστηκὼς ἐπὶ τείχους ἀδαμαντίνου καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ἀδάμας

text_en: And the Lord said to me: What do you see, Amos? And I said: A mason's trowel. And the Lord said: Behold, I will lay down the trowel in the midst of my people Israel . I will plaster them over no more.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Quid tu vides, Amos? Et dixi : Trullam cæmentarii. Et dixit Dominus : Ecce ego ponam trullam in medio populi mei Israël; non adjiciam ultra superinducere eum.
text_pt: E o Senhor me disse: Que vês tu, Amós? E eu disse: Um prumo. Então disse o Senhor: Eis que eu porei o prumo no meio do meu povo Israel; nunca mais passarei por ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με τί σὺ ὁρᾷς Αμως καὶ εἶπα ἀδάμαντα καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐντάσσω ἀδάμαντα ἐν μέσῳ λαοῦ μου Ισραηλ οὐκέτι μὴ προσθῶ τοῦ παρελθεῖν αὐτόν

text_en: And the high places of the idol shall be thrown down, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste: and I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
text_la: Et demolientur excelsa idoli, et sanctificationes Israël desolabuntur, et consurgam super domum Jeroboam in gladio.
text_pt: Mas os altos de Isaque serão assolados, e destruídos os santuários de Israel; e levantar-me-ei com a espada contra a casa de Jeroboão.
text_el: καὶ ἀφανισθήσονται βωμοὶ τοῦ γέλωτος καὶ αἱ τελεταὶ τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐξερημωθήσονται καὶ ἀναστήσομαι ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ιεροβοαμ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ

text_en: And Amasias the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel , saying: Amos has rebelled against you in the midst of the house of Israel : the land is not able to bear all his words.
text_la: Et misit Amasias, sacerdos Bethel, ad Jeroboam, regem Israël, dicens : Rebellavit contra te Amos in medio domus Israël; non poterit terra sustinere universos sermones ejus.
text_pt: Então Amazias, o sacerdote de Betel, mandou dizer a Jeroboão, rei de Israel: Amós tem conspirado contra ti, no meio da casa de Israel; a terra não poderá sofrer todas as suas palavras.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν Αμασιας ὁ ἱερεὺς Βαιθηλ πρὸς Ιεροβοαμ βασιλέα Ισραηλ λέγων συστροφὰς ποιεῖται κατὰ σοῦ Αμως ἐν μέσῳ οἴκου Ισραηλ οὐ μὴ δύνηται ἡ γῆ ὑπενεγκεῖν ἅπαντας τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ

text_en: For thus says Amos: Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall be carried away captive out of their own land.
text_la: Hæc enim dicit Amos : In gladio morietur Jeroboam, et Israël captivus migrabit de terra sua.
text_pt: Porque assim diz Amós: Jeroboão morrerá à espada, e Israel certamente será levado para fora da sua terra em cativeiro.
text_el: διότι τάδε λέγει Αμως ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ τελευτήσει Ιεροβοαμ ὁ δὲ Ισραηλ αἰχμάλωτος ἀχθήσεται ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Amasias said to Amos: You seer, go, flee away into the land of Juda : and eat bread there, and prophesy there.
text_la: Et dixit Amasias ad Amos : Qui vides, gradere : fuge in terram Juda, et comede ibi panem, et prophetabis ibi.
text_pt: Depois Amazias disse a Amós: Vai-te, ó vidente, e foge para a terra de Judá, e ali come o pão, e ali profetiza;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αμασιας πρὸς Αμως ὁ ὁρῶν βάδιζε ἐκχώρησον εἰς γῆν Ιουδα καὶ ἐκεῖ καταβίου καὶ ἐκεῖ προφητεύσεις

text_en: But prophesy not again any more in Bethel : because it is the king's sanctuary, and it is the house of the kingdom.
text_la: Et in Bethel non adjicies ultra ut prophetes, quia sanctificatio regis est, et domus regni est.
text_pt: Mas em Betel daqui por diante não profetizes mais, porque é o santuário do rei e casa real.
text_el: εἰς δὲ Βαιθηλ οὐκέτι μὴ προσθῇς τοῦ προφητεῦσαι ὅτι ἁγίασμα βασιλέως ἐστὶν καὶ οἶκος βασιλείας ἐστίν

text_en: And Amos answered and said to Amasias: I am not a prophet , nor am I the son of a prophet : but I am a herdsman plucking wild figs.
text_la: Responditque Amos, et dixit ad Amasiam : Non sum propheta, et non sum filius prophetæ : sed armentarius ego sum vellicans sycomoros.
text_pt: E respondeu Amós, dizendo a Amazias: Eu não sou profeta, nem filho de profeta, mas boiadeiro, e cultivador de sicômoros.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Αμως καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Αμασιαν οὐκ ἤμην προφήτης ἐγὼ οὐδὲ υἱὸς προφήτου ἀλλ' ἢ αἰπόλος ἤμην καὶ κνίζων συκάμινα

text_en: And the Lord took me when I followed the flock, and the Lord said to me: Go, prophesy to my people Israel .
text_la: Et tulit me Dominus cum sequerer gregem, et dixit Dominus ad me : Vade, propheta ad populum meum Israël.
text_pt: Mas o Senhor me tirou de seguir o rebanho, e o Senhor me disse: Vai, e profetiza ao meu povo Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέλαβέν με κύριος ἐκ τῶν προβάτων καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με βάδιζε προφήτευσον ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ

text_en: And now hear the word of the Lord : You say, you shall not prophesy against Israel , and you shall not drop your word upon the house of the idol .
text_la: Et nunc audi verbum Domini : Tu dicis : Non prophetabis super Israël, et non stillabis super domum idoli.
text_pt: Agora, pois, ouve a palavra do Senhor: Tu dizes: Não profetizes contra Israel, nem fales contra a casa de Isaque.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἄκουε λόγον κυρίου σὺ λέγεις μὴ προφήτευε ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ μὴ ὀχλαγωγήσῃς ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ιακωβ

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : Your wife shall play the harlot in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be measured by a line: and you shall die in a polluted land, and Israel shall go into captivity out of their land.
text_la: Propter hoc hæc dicit Dominus : Uxor tua in civitate fornicabitur, et filii tui et filiæ tuæ in gladio cadent, et humus tua funiculo metietur : et tu in terra polluta morieris, et Israël captivus migrabit de terra sua.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor: Tua mulher se prostituirá na cidade, e teus filhos e tuas filhas cairão à espada, e a tua terra será repartida a cordel, e tu morrerás na terra imunda, e Israel certamente será levado cativo para fora da sua terra.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἡ γυνή σου ἐν τῇ πόλει πορνεύσει καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες σου ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ πεσοῦνται καὶ ἡ γῆ σου ἐν σχοινίῳ καταμετρηθήσεται καὶ σὺ ἐν γῇ ἀκαθάρτῳ τελευτήσεις ὁ δὲ Ισραηλ αἰχμάλωτος ἀχθήσεται ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: These things the Lord showed to me: and behold a hook to draw down the fruit.
text_la: Hæc ostendit mihi Dominus Deus : et ecce uncinus pomorum.
text_pt: O SENHOR DEUS assim me fez ver: E eis aqui um cesto de frutos do verão.
text_el: οὕτως ἔδειξέν μοι κύριος καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄγγος ἰξευτοῦ

text_en: And he said: What do you see, Amos? And I said: A hook to draw down fruit. And the Lord said to me: The end has come upon my people Israel : I will not again pass by them any more.
text_la: Et dixit : Quid tu vides, Amos? Et dixi : Uncinum pomorum. Et dixit Dominus ad me : Venit finis super populum meum Israël; non adjiciam ultra ut pertranseam eum.
text_pt: E disse: Que vês, Amós? E eu disse: Um cesto de frutos do verão. Então o Senhor me disse: Chegou o fim sobre o meu povo Israel; nunca mais passarei por ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τί σὺ βλέπεις Αμως καὶ εἶπα ἄγγος ἰξευτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με ἥκει τὸ πέρας ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ οὐκέτι μὴ προσθῶ τοῦ παρελθεῖν αὐτόν

text_en: And the hinges of the temple shall screak in that day, says the Lord God : many shall die: silence shall be cast in every place.
text_la: Et stridebunt cardines templi in die illa, dicit Dominus Deus : multi morientur; in omni loco projicietur silentium.
text_pt: Mas os cânticos do templo naquele dia serão gemidos, diz o Senhor DEUS; multiplicar-se-ão os cadáveres; em todos os lugares serão lançados fora em silêncio.
text_el: καὶ ὀλολύξει τὰ φατνώματα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγει κύριος πολὺς ὁ πεπτωκὼς ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ἐπιρρίψω σιωπήν

text_en: Hear this, you that crush the poor , and make the needy of the land to fail,
text_la: Audite hoc, qui conteritis pauperem, et deficere facitis egenos terræ,
text_pt: Ouvi isto, vós que anelais o abatimento do necessitado; e destruís os miseráveis da terra,
text_el: ἀκούσατε δὴ ταῦτα οἱ ἐκτρίβοντες εἰς τὸ πρωὶ πένητα καὶ καταδυναστεύοντες πτωχοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: saying: When will the month be over, and we shall sell our wares: and the sabbath , and we shall open the corn: that we may lessen the measure, and increase the sicle, and may convey in deceitful balances,
text_la: dicentes : Quando transibit mensis, et venundabimus merces? et sabbatum, et aperiemus frumentum, ut imminuamus mensuram, et augeamus siclum, et supponamus stateras dolosas,
text_pt: Dizendo: Quando passará a lua nova, para vendermos o grão, e o sábado, para abrirmos os celeiros de trigo, diminuindo o efa, e aumentando o siclo, e procedendo dolosamente com balanças enganosas,
text_el: οἱ λέγοντες πότε διελεύσεται ὁ μὴν καὶ ἐμπολήσομεν καὶ τὰ σάββατα καὶ ἀνοίξομεν θησαυροὺς τοῦ ποιῆσαι μικρὸν μέτρον καὶ τοῦ μεγαλῦναι στάθμια καὶ ποιῆσαι ζυγὸν ἄδικον

text_en: that we may possess the needy for money, and the poor for a pair of shoes, and may sell the refuse of the corn?
text_la: ut possideamus in argento egenos et pauperes pro calceamentis, et quisquilias frumenti vendamus?
text_pt: Para comprarmos os pobres por dinheiro, e os necessitados por um par de sapatos, e para vendermos o refugo do trigo?
text_el: τοῦ κτᾶσθαι ἐν ἀργυρίῳ πτωχοὺς καὶ ταπεινὸν ἀντὶ ὑποδημάτων καὶ ἀπὸ παντὸς γενήματος ἐμπορευσόμεθα

text_en: The Lord has sworn against the pride of Jacob : surely I will never forget all their works.
text_la: Juravit Dominus in superbiam Jacob : Si oblitus fuero usque ad finem omnia opera eorum.
text_pt: Jurou o Senhor pela glória de Jacó: Eu não me esquecerei de todas as suas obras para sempre.
text_el: ὀμνύει κύριος καθ' ὑπερηφανίας Ιακωβ εἰ ἐπιλησθήσεται εἰς νεῖκος πάντα τὰ ἔργα ὑμῶν

text_en: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwells therein: and rise up altogether as a river, and be cast out, and run down as the river of Egypt ?
text_la: Numquid super isto non commovebitur terra, et lugebit omnis habitator ejus, et ascendet quasi fluvius universus, et ejicicetur, et defluet, quasi rivus Ægypti?
text_pt: Por causa disto não estremecerá a terra, e não chorará todo aquele que nela habita? Certamente levantar-se-á toda ela como o grande rio, e será agitada, e baixará como o rio do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τούτοις οὐ ταραχθήσεται ἡ γῆ καὶ πενθήσει πᾶς ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἀναβήσεται ὡς ποταμὸς συντέλεια καὶ καταβήσεται ὡς ποταμὸς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, says the Lord God , that the sun shall go down at midday, and I will make the earth dark in the day of light:
text_la: Et erit in die illa, dicit Dominus Deus : occidet sol in meridie, et tenebrescere faciam terram in die luminis :
text_pt: E sucederá que, naquele dia, diz o Senhor Deus, farei que o sol se ponha ao meio-dia, e a terra se entenebreça no dia claro.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός καὶ δύσεται ὁ ἥλιος μεσημβρίας καὶ συσκοτάσει ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τὸ φῶς

text_en: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation: and I will bring up sackcloth upon every back of yours, and baldness upon every head: and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the latter end thereof as a bitter day.
text_la: et convertam festivitates vestras in luctum, et omnia cantica vestra in planctum, et inducam super omne dorsum vestrum saccum, et super omne caput calvitium : et ponam eam quasi luctum unigeniti, et novissima ejus quasi diem amarum.
text_pt: E tornarei as vossas festas em luto, e todos os vossos cânticos em lamentações; e porei pano de saco sobre todos os lombos, e calva sobre toda cabeça; e farei que isso seja como luto por um filho único, e o seu fim como dia de amarguras.
text_el: καὶ μεταστρέψω τὰς ἑορτὰς ὑμῶν εἰς πένθος καὶ πάσας τὰς ᾠδὰς ὑμῶν εἰς θρῆνον καὶ ἀναβιβῶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ὀσφὺν σάκκον καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν κεφαλὴν φαλάκρωμα καὶ θήσομαι αὐτὸν ὡς πένθος ἀγαπητοῦ καὶ τοὺς μετ' αὐτοῦ ὡς ἡμέραν ὀδύνης

text_en: Behold the days come, says the Lord , and I will send forth a famine into the land: not a famine of bread, nor a thirst of water, but of hearing the word of the Lord .
text_la: Ecce dies veniunt, dicet Dominus, et mittam famem in terram : non famem panis, neque sitim aquæ, sed audiendi verbum Domini.
text_pt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor DEUS, em que enviarei fome sobre a terra; não fome de pão, nem sede de água, mas de ouvir as palavras do SENHOR.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται λέγει κύριος καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ λιμὸν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν οὐ λιμὸν ἄρτου οὐδὲ δίψαν ὕδατος ἀλλὰ λιμὸν τοῦ ἀκοῦσαι λόγον κυρίου

text_en: And they shall move from sea to sea, and from the north to the east: they shall go about seeking the word of the Lord , and shall not find it.
text_la: Et commovebuntur a mari usque ad mare, et ab aquilone usque ad orientem : circuibunt quærentes verbum Domini, et non invenient.
text_pt: E irão errantes de um mar até outro mar, e do norte até ao oriente; correrão por toda a parte, buscando a palavra do Senhor, mas não a acharão.
text_el: καὶ σαλευθήσονται ὕδατα ἕως θαλάσσης καὶ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ ἕως ἀνατολῶν περιδραμοῦνται ζητοῦντες τὸν λόγον κυρίου καὶ οὐ μὴ εὕρωσιν

text_en: In that day the fair virgins , and the young men shall faint for thirst.
text_la: In die illa deficient virgines pulchræ et adolescentes in siti,
text_pt: Naquele dia as virgens formosas e os jovens desmaiarão de sede.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐκλείψουσιν αἱ παρθένοι αἱ καλαὶ καὶ οἱ νεανίσκοι ἐν δίψει

text_en: They that swear by the sin of Samaria , and say: Your God , O Dan , lives: and the way of Bersabee lives: and they shall fall, and shall rise no more.
text_la: qui jurant in delicto Samariæ, et dicunt : Vivit Deus tuus, Dan, et vivit via Bersabee; et cadent, et non resurgent ultra.
text_pt: Os que juram pela culpa de Samaria, dizendo: Vive o teu deus, ó Dã; e vive o caminho de Berseba; esses mesmos cairão, e não se levantarão jamais.
text_el: οἱ ὀμνύοντες κατὰ τοῦ ἱλασμοῦ Σαμαρείας καὶ οἱ λέγοντες ζῇ ὁ θεός σου Δαν καὶ ζῇ ὁ θεός σου Βηρσαβεε καὶ πεσοῦνται καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀναστῶσιν ἔτι

text_en: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar , and he said: Strike the hinges, and let the lintels be shook: for there is covetousness in the head of them all, and I will slay the last of them with the sword: there shall be no flight for them: they shall flee, and he that shall flee of them shall not be delivered.
text_la: Vidi Dominum stantem super altare, et dixit : Percute cardinem, et commoveantur superliminaria : avaritia enim in capite omnium, et novissimum eorum in gladio interficiam; non erit fuga eis. Fugient, et non salvabitur ex eis qui fugerit.
text_pt: Vi o Senhor, que estava em pé sobre o altar; e me disse: Fere o capitel, e estremeçam os umbrais, e faze tudo em pedaços sobre a cabeça de todos eles; e eu matarei à espada até ao último deles; nenhum deles conseguirá fugir, nenhum deles escapará.
text_el: εἶδον τὸν κύριον ἐφεστῶτα ἐπὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ εἶπεν πάταξον ἐπὶ τὸ ἱλαστήριον καὶ σεισθήσεται τὰ πρόπυλα καὶ διάκοψον εἰς κεφαλὰς πάντων καὶ τοὺς καταλοίπους αὐτῶν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ ἀποκτενῶ οὐ μὴ διαφύγῃ ἐξ αὐτῶν φεύγων καὶ οὐ μὴ διασωθῇ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀνασῳζόμενος

text_en: Though they go down even to hell , thence shall my hand bring them out: and though they climb up to heaven , thence will I bring them down.
text_la: Si descenderint usque ad infernum, inde manus mea educet eos; et si ascenderint usque in cælum, inde detraham eos.
text_pt: Ainda que cavem até ao inferno, a minha mão os tirará dali; e, se subirem ao céu, dali os farei descer.
text_el: ἐὰν κατορυγῶσιν εἰς ᾅδου ἐκεῖθεν ἡ χείρ μου ἀνασπάσει αὐτούς καὶ ἐὰν ἀναβῶσιν εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν ἐκεῖθεν κατάξω αὐτούς

text_en: And though they be hid in the top of Carmel , I will search and take them away from thence: and though they hide themselves from my eyes in the depth of the sea, there will I command the serpent and he shall bite them.
text_la: Et si absconditi fuerint in vertice Carmeli, inde scrutans auferam eos; et si celaverint se ab oculis meis in profundo maris, ibi mandabo serpenti, et mordebit eos.
text_pt: E, se se esconderem no cume do Carmelo, buscá-los-ei, e dali os tirarei; e, se dos meus olhos se ocultarem no fundo do mar, ali darei ordem à serpente, e ela os picará.
text_el: ἐὰν ἐγκρυβῶσιν εἰς τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ Καρμήλου ἐκεῖθεν ἐξερευνήσω καὶ λήμψομαι αὐτούς καὶ ἐὰν καταδύσωσιν ἐξ ὀφθαλμῶν μου εἰς τὰ βάθη τῆς θαλάσσης ἐκεῖ ἐντελοῦμαι τῷ δράκοντι καὶ δήξεται αὐτούς

text_en: And if they go into captivity before their enemies, there will I command the sword, and it shall kill them. And I will set my eyes upon them for evil , and not for good .
text_la: Et si abierint in captivitatem coram inimicis suis, ibi mandabo gladio, et occidet eos : et ponam oculos meos super eos in malum, et non in bonum.
text_pt: E, se forem em cativeiro diante de seus inimigos, ali darei ordem à espada que os mate; e eu porei os meus olhos sobre eles para o mal, e não para o bem.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῶσιν ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ πρὸ προσώπου τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν ἐκεῖ ἐντελοῦμαι τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἀποκτενεῖ αὐτούς καὶ στηριῶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου ἐπ' αὐτοὺς εἰς κακὰ καὶ οὐκ εἰς ἀγαθά

text_en: And the Lord the God of hosts is he who touches the earth, and it shall melt: and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up as a river, and shall run down as the river of Egypt .
text_la: Et Dominus Deus exercituum, qui tangit terram, et tabescet, et lugebunt omnes habitantes in ea : et ascendet sicut rivus omnis, et defluet sicut fluvius Ægypti.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos é o que toca a terra, e ela se derrete, e todos os que habitam nela chorarão; e ela subirá toda como um rio, e abaixará como o rio do Egito.
text_el: καὶ κύριος κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ὁ ἐφαπτόμενος τῆς γῆς καὶ σαλεύων αὐτήν καὶ πενθήσουσιν πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτήν καὶ ἀναβήσεται ὡς ποταμὸς συντέλεια αὐτῆς καὶ καταβήσεται ὡς ποταμὸς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: He that builds his ascension in heaven , and has founded his bundle upon the earth: who calls the waters of the sea, and pours them out upon the face of the earth, the Lord is his name .
text_la: Qui ædificat in cælo ascensionem suam, et fasciculum suum super terram fundavit; qui vocat aquas maris, et effundit eas super faciem terræ : Dominus nomen ejus.
text_pt: Ele é o que edifica as suas câmaras superiores no céu, e fundou na terra a sua abóbada, e o que chama as águas do mar, e as derrama sobre a terra; o Senhor é o seu nome.
text_el: ὁ οἰκοδομῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνάβασιν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς θεμελιῶν ὁ προσκαλούμενος τὸ ὕδωρ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐκχέων αὐτὸ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ὄνομα αὐτῷ

text_en: Are not you as the children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel , says the Lord ? Did not I bring up Israel , out of the land of Egypt : and the Philistines out of Cappadocia, and the Syrians out of Cyrene ?
text_la: Numquid non ut filii Æthiopum vos estis mihi, filii Israël? ait Dominus. Numquid non Israël ascendere feci de terra Ægypti, et Palæstinos de Cappadocia, et Syros de Cyrene?
text_pt: Não me sois, vós, ó filhos de Israel, como os filhos dos etíopes? diz o Senhor: Não fiz eu subir a Israel da terra do Egito, e aos filisteus de Caftor, e aos sírios de Quir?
text_el: οὐχ ὡς υἱοὶ Αἰθιόπων ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐμοί υἱοὶ Ισραηλ λέγει κύριος οὐ τὸν Ισραηλ ἀνήγαγον ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους ἐκ Καππαδοκίας καὶ τοὺς Σύρους ἐκ βόθρου

text_en: Behold the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from the face of the earth: but yet I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob , says the Lord .
text_la: Ecce oculi Domini Dei super regnum peccans : et conteram illud a facie terræ; verumtamen conterens non conteram domum Jacob, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Eis que os olhos do Senhor DEUS estão contra este reino pecador, e eu o destruirei de sobre a face da terra; mas não destruirei de todo a casa de Jacó, diz o SENHOR.
